events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Your dispute is resolved in your favour: you'll get a full refund of the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee, paid back to the original payment method. It came down to two things: the driver cancelled after waiting at your pickup for just over six minutes, but before cancelling the driver only messaged you in the app and never tried calling you. A call is required before a no-show fee can stand, so the fee can't be charged. There's no flag on your account. Nothing you need to do — the refund goes back to your card automatically.

DRIVER: The no-show fee for this trip has been voided and the $5.00 refunded to the rider's original payment method. The record shows you reached the pickup and waited long enough, but before cancelling you sent in-app messages and made no call to the rider. A call attempt is required before a no-show fee can be charged, so this fee doesn't stand. No further action is needed from you, and this cancellation isn't counted against you. Keep calling the rider through the app before cancelling so future no-show fees hold up.
